A 探针完整输入文件 work-A/dist/src/interpreter.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："const DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH = 200_000;\nfunction stepOnce(rules, input) {\n    for (let position = 0; position < input.length; position++) {\n        let chosen = null;\n        for (const rule of rules) {\n            if (!input.startsWith(rule.lhs, position)) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (chosen === null ||\n                rule.lhs.length > chosen.lhs.length ||\n                (rule.lhs.length === chosen.lhs.length && rule.id < chosen.id)) {\n                chosen = rule;\n            }\n        }\n        if (chosen !== null) {\n            return input.slice(0, position) + chosen.rhs + input.slice(position + chosen.lhs.length);\n        }\n    }\n    return null;\n}\nexport function interpret(rules, input, options) {\n    const maxLength = options.maxLength ?? DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH;\n    const states = [input];\n    let current = input;\n    for (let step = 0; step < options.maxSteps; step++) {\n        const next = stepOnce(rules, current);\n        if (next === null) {\n            return { states, halted: true, truncated: false };\n        }\n        if (next.length > maxLength) {\n            return { states, halted: false, truncated: true };\n        }\n        current = next;\n        states.push(current);\n    }\n    return { states, halted: false, truncated: false };\n}\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 work-A/dist/src/rewrite.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："import { interpret } from './interpreter.js';\nexport const DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 10_000;\nexport const DEFAULT_VERIFY_MAX_LENGTH = 200_000;\nexport function validateRules(rules) {\n    const seen = new Set();\n    for (const rule of rules) {\n        if (rule.id.length === 0) {\n            throw new Error('rule id must be non-empty');\n        }\n        if (seen.has(rule.id)) {\n            throw new Error(`duplicate rule id: ${rule.id}`);\n        }\n        seen.add(rule.id);\n        if (rule.lhs.length === 0) {\n            throw new Error(`rule ${rule.id}: lhs must be non-empty`);\n        }\n    }\n}\nexport function selectMatch(rules, input) {\n    let best = null;\n    for (const rule of rules) {\n        const position = input.indexOf(rule.lhs);\n        if (position === -1) {\n            continue;\n        }\n        if (best === null ||\n            position < best.position ||\n            (position === best.position && rule.lhs.length > best.rule.lhs.length) ||\n            (position === best.position && rule.lhs.length === best.rule.lhs.length && rule.id < best.rule.id)) {\n            best = { rule, position };\n        }\n    }\n    return best;\n}\nexport function applyMatch(input, match) {\n    const { rule, position } = match;\n    return input.slice(0, position) + rule.rhs + input.slice(position + rule.lhs.length);\n}\nfunction makeTrace(original, steps, outcome) {\n    const last = steps[steps.length - 1];\n    return { original, steps, final: last === undefined ? original : last.after, outcome };\n}\nexport function verifyTraceWithInterpreter(rules, trace, maxSteps, verifyMaxLength = DEFAULT_VERIFY_MAX_LENGTH) {\n    const states = [trace.original];\n    for (const step of trace.steps) {\n        states.push(step.after);\n    }\n    const result = interpret(rules, trace.original, { maxSteps, maxLength: verifyMaxLength });\n    if (result.truncated) {\n        return {\n            checked: false,\n            consistent: false,\n            comparedStates: 0,\n            firstDivergence: null,\n            reason: `interpreter aborted: state exceeded ${verifyMaxLength} chars`,\n        };\n    }\n    let firstDivergence = null;\n    const compared = Math.min(states.length, result.states.length);\n    for (let i = 0; i < compared; i++) {\n        if (states[i] !== result.states[i]) {\n            firstDivergence = i;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    const consistent = firstDivergence === null &&\n        states.length === result.states.length &&\n        result.halted === (trace.outcome.kind === 'normal-form');\n    return { checked: true, consistent, comparedStates: compared, firstDivergence };\n}\nexport function rewrite(rules, input, options = {}) {\n    validateRules(rules);\n    const maxSteps = options.maxSteps ?? DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS;\n    if (!Number.isInteger(maxSteps) || maxSteps < 0) {\n        throw new Error(`maxSteps must be a non-negative integer, got ${maxSteps}`);\n    }\n    const seen = new Map();\n    const steps = [];\n    let current = input;\n    seen.set(current, 0);\n    for (let index = 0; index < maxSteps; index++) {\n        const match = selectMatch(rules, current);\n        if (match === null) {\n            return makeTrace(input, steps, { kind: 'normal-form', steps: steps.length });\n        }\n        const before = current;\n        const after = applyMatch(before, match);\n        steps.push({\n            index,\n            ruleId: match.rule.id,\n            position: match.position,\n            removed: match.rule.lhs,\n            inserted: match.rule.rhs,\n            before,\n            after,\n        });\n        current = after;\n        const stateIndex = steps.length;\n        const firstSeen = seen.get(current);\n        if (firstSeen !== undefined) {\n            const evidence = {\n                state: current,\n                firstSeenAt: firstSeen,\n                repeatedAt: stateIndex,\n                cycleLength: stateIndex - firstSeen,\n                cycleSteps: steps.slice(firstSeen),\n            };\n            return makeTrace(input, steps, { kind: 'cycle', evidence });\n        }\n        seen.set(current, stateIndex);\n    }\n    const trace = makeTrace(input, steps, {\n        kind: 'budget-exhausted',\n        steps: steps.length,\n        verification: {\n            checked: false,\n            consistent: false,\n            comparedStates: 0,\n            firstDivergence: null,\n            reason: 'verification not run',\n        },\n    });\n    const verification = verifyTraceWithInterpreter(rules, trace, maxSteps, options.verifyMaxLength);\n    return makeTrace(input, steps, { kind: 'budget-exhausted', steps: steps.length, verification });\n}\nexport function undo(trace) {\n    let current = trace.final;\n    for (let i = trace.steps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n        const step = trace.steps[i];\n        if (step === undefined || !current.startsWith(step.inserted, step.position)) {\n            throw new Error(`trace inconsistent at step ${step?.index ?? i}`);\n        }\n        current = current.slice(0, step.position) + step.removed + current.slice(step.position + step.inserted.length);\n    }\n    return current;\n}\nexport function stateAt(trace, index) {\n    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index > trace.steps.length) {\n        throw new RangeError(`state index ${index} out of range 0..${trace.steps.length}`);\n    }\n    let current = trace.original;\n    for (let i = 0; i < index; i++) {\n        const step = trace.steps[i];\n        if (step === undefined) {\n            throw new Error(`trace missing step ${i}`);\n        }\n        current = current.slice(0, step.position) + step.inserted + current.slice(step.position + step.removed.length);\n    }\n    return current;\n}\n"

});\n    test('longest lhs wins at the same position', () => {\n        const rules = [\n            { id: 'r-short', lhs: 'a', rhs: 'x' },\n            { id: 'r-long', lhs: 'ab', rhs: 'y' },\n beats longer lhs further right', () => {\n        const rules = [\n            { id: 'r-long', lhs: 'bcd', rhs: 'X' },\n            { id: 'r-short', lhs: 'a', rhs: 'Y' },\n        ];\n        const });\n    test('deletion rules (empty rhs) are supported', () => {\n        const trace = rewrite([{ id: 'del', lhs: 'x', rhs: '' }], 'axbx');\n        assert.equal(trace.final, 'ab');\n {\n        assert.equal(undo(trace), 'zabz');\n        assert.equal(undo(trace), trace.original);\n    });\n    test('every step records source state and forms a chain', () => {\n        assert.equal(trace.original, 'zabz');\n        for (let i = 0; i < trace.steps.length; i++) {\n            const step = trace.steps[i];\n            assert.equal(step.before, stateAt(trace, i));\n DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH;\n  const states: string[] = [input];\n  let current = input;\n  for (let step = 0; step < options.maxSteps; step++) {\n    const next = stepOnce(rules, current);\n    if (next === null) {\n      return { states, halted: true, truncated: false };\n    }\n    if (next.length > maxLength) {\n      return { states, halted: false, truncated: true };\n    }\n    current = next;\n    states.push(current);\n  }\n  return { states, halted: false, truncated: false };\n}\n"

const DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 10_000;\nexport const DEFAULT_VERIFY_MAX_LENGTH = 200_000;\n\nexport function validateRules(rules: readonly Rule[]): void {\n  const seen = new Set<string>();\n  for (const rule of rules) {\n    if (rule.id.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('rule id must be non-empty');\n    }\n    if (seen.has(rule.id)) {\n      throw new Error(`duplicate rule id: ${rule.id}`);\n readonly position: number;\n}\n\nexport function selectMatch(rules: readonly Rule[], input: string): Match | null {\n  let best: Match | null = null;\n  for (const rule of rules) {\n    const position = input.indexOf(rule.lhs);\n    if (position === -1) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    if (\n      best === null ||\n      position < best.position ||\n      (position === best.position && rule.lhs.length > best.rule.lhs.length) ||\n      (position === best.position && rule.lhs.length === best.rule.lhs.length && rule.id < best.rule.id)\n    ) {\n      best = { rule, position };\n    }\n rule.lhs.length);\n}\n\nfunction makeTrace(original: string, steps: Step[], outcome: Outcome): Trace {\n  const last = steps[steps.length - 1];\n  return { original, steps, final: last === undefined ? original : last.after, outcome };\n}\n\nexport function verifyTraceWithInterpreter(\n  rules: readonly Rule[],\n  trace: Trace,\n  maxSteps: number,\n  verifyMaxLength: number = DEFAULT_VERIFY_MAX_LENGTH,\n): Verification {\n  const states: string[] = [trace.original];\n  for (const step of trace.steps) {\n    states.push(step.after);\n  }\n  const result = interpret(rules, trace.original, { maxSteps, maxLength: verifyMaxLength });\n  if (result.truncated) {\n    return {\n      checked: false,\n      consistent: false,\n      comparedStates: 0,\n      firstDivergence: result.states.length);\n  for (let i = 0; i < compared; i++) {\n    if (states[i] !== result.states[i]) {\n      firstDivergence = i;\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n  const consistent =\n    firstDivergence === null &&\n    states.length === result.states.length &&\n    result.halted === (trace.outcome.kind === 'normal-form');\n  return { checked: true, consistent, comparedStates: compared, firstDivergence };\n}\n\nexport function rewrite(rules: readonly Rule[], input: string, options: RewriteOptions = {}): Trace {\n  validateRules(rules);\n  const maxSteps = options.maxSteps ?? DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS;\n  if (!Number.isInteger(maxSteps) || maxSteps < 0) {\n    throw new Error(`maxSteps must be a non-negative integer, got ${maxSteps}`);\n  }\n  const seen = new Map<string, number>();\n  const steps: Step[] = [];\n  let current = input;\n  seen.set(current, 0);\n\n  for (let index = 0; index < maxSteps; index++) {\n    const match = selectMatch(rules, current);\n    if (match === null) {\n      return makeTrace(input, steps, { kind: 'normal-form', steps: steps.length });\n    }\n    const before = current;\n    const after = applyMatch(before, match);\n    steps.push({\n      index,\n      ruleId: match.rule.id,\n      position: match.position,\n      removed: match.rule.lhs,\n      inserted: match.rule.rhs,\n      before,\n      after,\n    });\n    current = after;\n    const stateIndex = steps.length;\n    const firstSeen = seen.get(current);\n    if (firstSeen !== undefined) {\n      const evidence: CycleEvidence = {\n        state: current,\n        firstSeenAt: firstSeen,\n        repeatedAt: stateIndex,\n        cycleLength: stateIndex - firstSeen,\n        cycleSteps: steps.slice(firstSeen),\n      };\n      return makeTrace(input, steps, { kind: 'cycle', evidence });\n    }\n    seen.set(current, stateIndex);\n  }\n\n  const trace = makeTrace(input, steps, {\n    kind: 'budget-exhausted',\n    steps: steps.length,\n    verification: {\n      checked: false,\n      consistent: false,\n      comparedStates: 0,\n      firstDivergence: null,\n      reason: 'verification not run',\n    },\n  });\n  const verification = verifyTraceWithInterpreter(rules, trace, maxSteps, options.verifyMaxLength);\n  return makeTrace(input, steps, { kind: 'budget-exhausted', steps: steps.length, verification });\n}\n\nexport function undo(trace: Trace): string {\n  let current = trace.final;\n  for (let i = trace.steps.length - 1; 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);\nlines.push(`RESULT 非BMP 来源数组 ${nonbmp.provenance.length} 项 != 当前串 ${nonbmpCP} 个码点`);\nconsole.log(lines.join('\\n'));\nprocess.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);\n"

'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);\nlines.push(`RESULT 来源串接 \"${chars}\" != final \"${r.final}\"，code-unit 位置 splice 码点数组而错位`);\nconsole.log(lines.join('\\n'));\nprocess.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);\n"

Default true. */\n    crossCheckOnBudgetExhaustion?: boolean;\n}\nexport declare function validateRules(rules: readonly Rule[]): void;\nexport interface Match {\n    rule: Rule;\n    position: number;\n}\n/**\n * Pick the next match: leftmost position, then longest LHS, then smallest\n * rule id. Returns null when no rule matches (normal form reached).\n */\nexport declare function selectMatch(rules: readonly Rule[], state: string): Match | null;\n/** Undo a full history of inverse deltas, returning the reconstructed string. */\nexport declare function undoAll(finalState: string, deltas: readonly InverseDelta[]): string;\nexport declare function run(rules: readonly Rule[], input: string, options: RunOptions): RunResult;\n/**\n * Naive short-string interpreter: an independent, deliberately simple\n * implementation of the same selection semantics, operating on plain\n * strings only. Full-state repetition is detected and\n * reported as cycle evidence. Returns null when no rule matches (normal form reached).\n */\nexport function selectMatch(rules, state) {\n    let best = null;\n    for (const rule of rules) {\n        const position = state.indexOf(rule.lhs);\n        if (position === -1)\n            continue;\n        if (best === null ||\n            position < best.position ||\n            (position === best.position && rule.lhs.length > best.rule.lhs.length) ||\n            (position === best.position &&\n                rule.lhs.length === best.rule.lhs.length &&\n                rule.id < best.rule.id)) {\n            best = { rule, position };\n        }\n    }\n    return best;\n}\n/** Undo a full history of inverse deltas, returning the reconstructed string. */\nexport function undoAll(finalState, deltas) {\n    let state = finalState;\n    for (let i = deltas.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n        const d = deltas[i];\n        if (state.slice(d.position, d.position + d.inserted.length) !== d.inserted) {\n            throw new Error(`inverse delta at step ${d.step} does not apply: ` +\n                `expected \"${d.inserted}\" at position ${d.position} of \"${state}\"`);\n        }\n        state = state.slice(0, d.position) + d.removed + state.slice(d.position + d.inserted.length);\n    }\n    return state;\n}\nexport function run(rules, input, options) {\n    validateRules(rules);\n    const crossCheckFlag = options.crossCheckOnBudgetExhaustion !== false;\n    let state = input;\n    let tokens = [...input].map((ch, index) => ({\n        ch,\n        origin: { kind: 'original', index },\n    }));\n    const steps = [];\n    const seen = new Map([[input, 0]]);\n    let status = null;\n    let cycleEvidence = null;\n    for (let step = 1;; step++) {\n        const match = selectMatch(rules, state);\n        if (match === null) {\n            status = { kind: 'normal-form', steps: steps.length };\n            break;\n        }\n        if (step > options.budget) {\n [...rule.rhs].map((ch) => ({\n            ch,\n            origin: { kind: 'produced', ruleId: rule.id, step },\n        }));\n        tokens = [...tokens.slice(0, position), ...produced, ...tokens.slice(position + rule.lhs.length)];\n        steps.push({\n            step,\n            ruleId: rule.id,\n            position,\n            removed,\n            inserted: rule.rhs,\n inverseDeltas = steps.map(({ step, ruleId, position, removed, inserted }) => ({\n        step,\n        ruleId,\n        position,\n        removed,\n        inserted,\n    }));\n    let crossCheck = null;\n    if (status.kind === 'budget-exhausted' && crossCheckFlag) {\n        crossCheck = crossCheckWithInterpreter(rules, input, steps);\n    }\n    return {\n        status,\n        initial: input,\n        final: state,\n        steps,\n        inverseDeltas,\n        provenance: tokens,\n        cycleEvidence,\n        crossCheck,\n    };\n}\nfunction crossCheckWithInterpreter(rules, if (trajectory[i + 1] !== engineSteps[i].stateAfter) {\n            firstDivergenceStep = engineSteps[i].step;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    let undoRestoresOriginal = false;\n    try {\n interpretTrajectory, validateRules, } from '../src/rewrite.js';\ntest('selection: leftmost position wins over longer LHS elsewhere', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'aaa', rhs: 'x' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'b', rhs: 'y' },\n    ];\n    // 'b' sits at position 0, 'aaa' at position 1 -> rule 2 fires first.\n    const match = selectMatch(rules, 'baaa');\n    assert.equal(match?.rule.id, 2);\n    assert.equal(match?.position, 0);\n});\ntest('selection: longest LHS breaks a same-position tie', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'x' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'ab', rhs: 'y' },\n    ];\n    const match = selectMatch(rules, 'ab');\n    assert.equal(match?.rule.id, 2);\n});\ntest('selection: smallest rule id breaks a same-position same-length tie', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 5, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'x' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'y' },\n    ];\n    const match = selectMatch(rules, 'a');\n    assert.equal(match?.rule.id, 2);\n    const result = run(rules, 'a', { budget: 10 });\n    assert.equal(result.final, 'y');\n});\ntest('selection: returns null at normal form', () => {\n    assert.equal(selectMatch([{ id: 1, lhs: 'z', rhs: 'w' }], 'abc'), null);\n});\ntest('rules may shrink and grow the string', () => {\n    const shrink = run([{ id: 1, lhs: 'aa', rhs: 'a' }], 'aaaa', { budget: 10 });\n    assert.equal(shrink.status.kind, 'normal-form');\n    assert.equal(shrink.final, 'a');\n    const grow = run([{ id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'aa' }], 'a', { budget: 4 });\n    assert.equal(grow.status.kind, 'budget-exhausted');\n    assert.equal(grow.final, 'aaaaa');\n});\ntest('inverse deltas undo every step back to the original input', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'ab', rhs: 'ba' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'aa', rhs: 'b' },\n    ];\n    const result = run(rules, 'aaba', { budget: 50 });\n    assert.equal(result.status.kind, 'normal-form');\n    assert.ok(result.steps.length > 0);\n    assert.equal(undoAll(result.final, result.inverseDeltas), 'aaba');\n});\ntest('undoAll rejects an inverse delta that does not apply', () => {\n    assert.throws(() => undoAll('xyz', [{ step: 1, ruleId: 1, position: 0, removed: 'a', inserted: 'q' }]), /does not apply/);\n});\ntest('provenance tracks original indices and produced characters', () => {\n    const result = run([{ id: 7, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'cd' }], 'ab', { budget: 10 });\n    assert.equal(result.final, 'cdb');\n    assert.deepEqual(result.provenance, [\n        { ch: 'c', origin: { kind: 'produced', ruleId: 7, step: 1 } },\n        { ch: 'd', origin: { kind: 'produced', ruleId: 7, step: 1 } },\n        { ch: 'b', origin: { kind: 'original', index: 1 } },\n    ]);\n});\ntest('provenance survives length-changing multi-step runs', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'bb' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'bbb', rhs: 'c' },\n    ];\n    const result = run(rules, 'aa', { budget: 20 });\n    assert.equal(result.final, 'cb');\n    assert.deepEqual(result.provenance.map((t) => t.origin), [\n        { kind: 'produced', ruleId: 2, step: 3 },\n        { kind: 'produced', ruleId: 1, step: 2 },\n    ]);\n});\ntest('full-state repetition yields cycle evidence', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'b' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'b', rhs: 'a' },\n    ];\n    const result = run(rules, 'a', { budget: 100 });\n    assert.deepEqual(result.status, {\n        kind: 'cycle',\n        steps: 2,\n        cycleStart: 0,\n        cycleLength: 2,\n    });\n    assert.equal(result.cycleEvidence?.length, 2);\n    // Replaying the evidence from the cycle start returns to the same state.\n    const replayed = result.cycleEvidence.reduce((state, s) => state.slice(0, s.position) + s.inserted + state.slice(s.position + s.removed.length), 'a');\n    assert.equal(replayed, 'a');\n});\ntest('cycle detection works with an offset before the loop', () => {\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'xa', rhs: 'a' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'ab' },\n        { id: 3, lhs: 'ab', rhs: 'a' },\n    ];\n    const result = run(rules, 'xa', { budget: 100 });\n    assert.equal(result.status.kind, 'cycle');\n    if (result.status.kind === 'cycle') {\n        assert.equal(result.status.cycleStart, 1);\n        assert.equal(result.status.cycleLength, 2);\n    }\n});\ntest('normal form when no rule applies', () => {\n    const result = run([{ id: 1, lhs: 'z', rhs: 'w' }], 'abc', { budget: 10 });\n    assert.deepEqual(result.status, { kind: 'normal-form', steps: 0 });\n    assert.equal(result.final, 'abc');\n    assert.equal(result.crossCheck, null);\n});\ntest('budget exhaustion triggers interpreter cross-check', () => {\n    const result = run([{ id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'aa' }], 'a', { budget: 10 });\n    assert.deepEqual(result.status, { kind: 'budget-exhausted', steps: 10 });\n    assert.equal(result.final.length, 11);\n    assert.deepEqual(result.crossCheck, {\n        interpreterAgrees: true,\n        firstDivergenceStep: null,\n        undoRestoresOriginal: true,\n    });\n});\ntest('cross-check agrees on a mixed grow/shrink system', () => {\n    // a -> bb grows, bbb -> c shrinks; both fire within the budget window.\n    const rules = [\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'bb' },\n        { id: 2, lhs: 'bbb', rhs: 'c' },\n    ];\n    const result = run(rules, 'aaaaa', { budget: 5 });\n    assert.equal(result.status.kind, 'budget-exhausted');\n    assert.deepEqual(['aaaaa', ...result.steps.map((s) => s.stateAfter)], ['aaaaa', 'bbaaaa', 'bbbbaaa', 'cbaaa', 'cbbbaa', 'ccaa']);\n    assert.equal(result.crossCheck?.interpreterAgrees, true);\n    assert.equal(result.crossCheck?.undoRestoresOriginal, true);\n    // Independent interpreter reproduces the same trajectory.\n    const trajectory = interpretTrajectory(rules, 'aaaaa', 5);\n    assert.deepEqual(['aaaaa', ...result.steps.map((s) => s.stateAfter)], trajectory);\n});\ntest('cross-check can be disabled', () => {\n    const result = run([{ id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'aa' }], 'a', {\n        budget: 3,\n        crossCheckOnBudgetExhaustion: false,\n    });\n    assert.equal(result.status.kind, 'budget-exhausted');\n    assert.equal(result.crossCheck, null);\n});\ntest('rule validation rejects empty LHS and duplicate ids', () => {\n    assert.throws(() => validateRules([{ id: 1, lhs: '', rhs: 'a' }]), /empty left-hand side/);\n    assert.throws(() => validateRules([\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'a', rhs: 'b' },\n        { id: 1, lhs: 'c', rhs: 'd' },\n    ]), /duplicate rule id/);\n});\n//# sourceMappingURL=rewrite.test.js.map"

B 探针完整输入文件 work-B/src/rewrite.ts以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/**\n * Deterministic string rewriting engine.\n *\n * Step selection order (single step):\n *   1. leftmost match position (each rule contributes its first occurrence)\n *   2. longest left-hand side\n *   3. smallest rule id\n *\n * Rules may grow or shrink the string. Every applied step records an\n * inverse delta (enough to undo the step) and per-character provenance\n * back to the original input. Full-state repetition is detected and\n * reported as cycle evidence. If the step budget is exhausted before\n * closure (normal form or cycle), the run is cross-checked against an\n * independent short-string interpreter.\n */\n\nexport interface Rule {\n  id: number;\n  lhs: string;\n  rhs: string;\n}\n\nexport type Origin =\n  | { kind: 'original'; index: number }\n  | { kind: 'produced'; ruleId: number; step: number };\n\nexport interface Token {\n  ch: string;\n  origin: Origin;\n}\n\nexport interface InverseDelta {\n  step: number;\n  ruleId: number;\n  position: number;\n  removed: string;\n  inserted: string;\n}\n\nexport interface StepRecord extends InverseDelta {\n  stateBefore: string;\n  stateAfter: string;\n}\n\nexport type RunStatus =\n  | { kind: 'normal-form'; steps: number }\n  | { kind: 'cycle'; steps: number; cycleStart: number; cycleLength: number }\n  | { kind: 'budget-exhausted'; steps: number };\n\nexport interface CrossCheckReport {\n  interpreterAgrees: boolean;\n  firstDivergenceStep: number | null;\n  undoRestoresOriginal: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface RunResult {\n  status: RunStatus;\n  initial: string;\n  final: string;\n  steps: StepRecord[];\n  inverseDeltas: InverseDelta[];\n  provenance: Token[];\n  cycleEvidence: StepRecord[] | null;\n  crossCheck: CrossCheckReport | null;\n}\n\nexport interface RunOptions {\n  budget: number;\n  /** Cross-check with the naive interpreter when the budget is exhausted. Default true. */\n  crossCheckOnBudgetExhaustion?: boolean;\n}\n\nexport function validateRules(rules: readonly Rule[]): void {\n  const seen = new Set<number>();\n  for (const rule of rules) {\n    if (!Number.isInteger(rule.id)) {\n      throw new Error(`rule id must be an integer, got ${rule.id}`);\n    }\n    if (seen.has(rule.id)) {\n      throw new Error(`duplicate rule id ${rule.id}`);\n    }\n    seen.add(rule.id);\n    if (rule.lhs.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error(`rule ${rule.id} has an empty left-hand side`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface Match {\n  rule: Rule;\n  position: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pick the next match: leftmost position, then longest LHS, then smallest\n * rule id. Returns null when no rule matches (normal form reached).\n */\nexport function selectMatch(rules: readonly Rule[], state: string): Match | null {\n  let best: Match | null = null;\n  for (const rule of rules) {\n    const position = state.indexOf(rule.lhs);\n    if (position === -1) continue;\n    if (\n      best === null ||\n      position < best.position ||\n      (position === best.position && rule.lhs.length > best.rule.lhs.length) ||\n      (position === best.position &&\n        rule.lhs.length === best.rule.lhs.length &&\n        rule.id < best.rule.id)\n    ) {\n      best = { rule, position };\n    }\n  }\n  return best;\n}\n\n/** Undo a full history of inverse deltas, returning the reconstructed string. */\nexport function undoAll(finalState: string, deltas: readonly InverseDelta[]): string {\n  let state = finalState;\n  for (let i = deltas.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n    const d = deltas[i];\n    if (state.slice(d.position, d.position + d.inserted.length) !== d.inserted) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `inverse delta at step ${d.step} does not apply: ` +\n          `expected \"${d.inserted}\" at position ${d.position} of \"${state}\"`,\n      );\n    }\n    state = state.slice(0, d.position) + d.removed + state.slice(d.position + d.inserted.length);\n  }\n  return state;\n}\n\nexport function run(\n  rules: readonly Rule[],\n  input: string,\n  options: RunOptions,\n): RunResult {\n  validateRules(rules);\n  const crossCheckFlag = options.crossCheckOnBudgetExhaustion !== false;\n\n  let state = input;\n  let tokens: Token[] = [...input].map((ch, index) => ({\n    ch,\n    origin: { kind: 'original', index } as Origin,\n  }));\n\n  const steps: StepRecord[] = [];\n  const seen = new Map<string, number>([[input, 0]]);\n  let status: RunStatus | null = null;\n  let cycleEvidence: StepRecord[] | null = null;\n\n  for (let step = 1; ; step++) {\n    const match = selectMatch(rules, state);\n    if (match === null) {\n      status = { kind: 'normal-form', steps: steps.length };\n      break;\n    }\n    if (step > options.budget) {\n      status = { kind: 'budget-exhausted', steps: steps.length };\n      break;\n    }\n\n    const { rule, position } = match;\n    const stateBefore = state;\n    const removed = state.slice(position, position + rule.lhs.length);\n    state =\n      state.slice(0, position) + rule.rhs + state.slice(position + rule.lhs.length);\n\n    const produced: Token[] = [...rule.rhs].map((ch) => ({\n      ch,\n      origin: { kind: 'produced', ruleId: rule.id, step } as Origin,\n    }));\n    tokens = [...tokens.slice(0, position), ...produced, ...tokens.slice(position + rule.lhs.length)];\n\n    steps.push({\n      step,\n      ruleId: rule.id,\n      position,\n      removed,\n      inserted: rule.rhs,\n      stateBefore,\n      stateAfter: state,\n    });\n\n    const previous = seen.get(state);\n    if (previous !== undefined) {\n      status = { kind: 'cycle', steps: steps.length, cycleStart: previous, cycleLength: step - previous };\n      cycleEvidence = steps.slice(previous);\n      break;\n    }\n    seen.set(state, step);\n  }\n\n  const inverseDeltas: InverseDelta[] = steps.map(\n    ({ step, ruleId, position, removed, inserted }) => ({\n      step,\n      ruleId,\n      position,\n      removed,\n      inserted,\n    }),\n  );\n\n  let crossCheck: CrossCheckReport | null = null;\n  if (status.kind === 'budget-exhausted' && crossCheckFlag) {\n    crossCheck = crossCheckWithInterpreter(rules, input, steps);\n  }\n\n  return {\n    status,\n    initial: input,\n    final: state,\n    steps,\n    inverseDeltas,\n    provenance: tokens,\n    cycleEvidence,\n    crossCheck,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction crossCheckWithInterpreter(\n  rules: readonly Rule[],\n  input: string,\n  engineSteps: readonly StepRecord[],\n): CrossCheckReport {\n  const trajectory = interpretTrajectory(rules, input, engineSteps.length);\n  let firstDivergenceStep: number | null = null;\n  for (let i = 0; i < engineSteps.length; i++) {\n    if (trajectory[i + 1] !== engineSteps[i].stateAfter) {\n      firstDivergenceStep = engineSteps[i].step;\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n  let undoRestoresOriginal = false;\n  try {\n    undoRestoresOriginal = undoAll(\n      engineSteps.length === 0 ? input : engineSteps[engineSteps.length - 1].stateAfter,\n      engineSteps,\n    ) === input;\n  } catch {\n    undoRestoresOriginal = false;\n  }\n  return {\n    interpreterAgrees: firstDivergenceStep === null,\n    firstDivergenceStep,\n    undoRestoresOriginal,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Naive short-string interpreter: an independent, deliberately simple\n * implementation of the same selection semantics, operating on plain\n * strings only. Returns the state trajectory (index 0 = input).\n */\nexport function interpretTrajectory(\n  rules: readonly Rule[],\n  input: string,\n  stepCount: number,\n): string[] {\n  validateRules(rules);\n  const sorted = [...rules].sort(\n    (a, b) => b.lhs.length - a.lhs.length || a.id - b.id,\n  );\n  const states = [input];\n  let state = input;\n  for (let n = 0; n < stepCount; n++) {\n    let bestPos = -1;\n    let best: Rule | null = null;\n    for (const rule of sorted) {\n      const pos = state.indexOf(rule.lhs);\n      if (pos !== -1 && (bestPos === -1 || pos < bestPos)) {\n        bestPos = pos;\n        best = rule;\n      }\n    }\n    if (best === null) break;\n    state = state.slice(0, bestPos) + best.rhs + state.slice(bestPos + best.lhs.length);\n    states.push(state);\n  }\n  return states;\n}\n"
